title: De Havilland Dash 8 客機工程
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以Dash 8客機類型比較振動激振、結構模態與主動系統的資料需求；把槳通過頻率和機身固有頻率區別後才談降振。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the Dash 8 type to compare excitation, structural modes and data needs of active systems, distinguishing blade-passing frequency from airframe natural frequency before discussing vibration reduction. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 螺槳效率的共同測點：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Common operating point for propeller efficiency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 螺槳效率的共同測點 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Common operating point for propeller efficiency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。
steps.instructionEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非De Havilland Dash 8 客機工程實際性能或製程：T=500 N，V=30 m/s，Pshaft=20000 W。式 ηp=TV/Pshaft，基準結果 0.75 fraction。適用條件：穩態前進飛行能量比，未含引擎熱效率，不是真機螺槳設定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for De Havilland Dash 8 airliner engineering: T=500 N, V=30 m/s and shaft power=20000 W. Formula ηp=TV/Pshaft gives 0.75 fraction. Conditions: Steady forward-flight energy ratio, excluding engine thermal efficiency and not defining propeller settings.
steps.failure: 計算η大於1表示單位、時序或能量邊界錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Efficiency above one indicates a unit, timing or energy-boundary error.
steps.check: 同時比較推力、速度與軸功率，排除不同測點的最大值拼接。
steps.checkEn: Compare thrust, speed and shaft power simultaneously rather than joining maxima from different conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把Pshaft改成25000 W；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 0.75 改為 0.6 fraction。在算式區重算並記下對「螺槳效率的共同測點」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only shaft power to 25000 W, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 0.75 to 0.6 fraction. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Common operating point for propeller efficiency, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「De Havilland Dash 8 客機工程」的「螺槳效率的共同測點：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Common operating point for propeller efficiency: Mechanism and observation” in “De Havilland Dash 8 airliner engineering”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
將不同條件的最大推力與最小功率相除仍可得到效率。
optionsEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Combining maximum thrust and minimum power from different conditions gives valid efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 前進飛行的理想有用功率為推力乘速度，除軸功率得到推進效率；靜止時此效率定義不適合比較懸停。 同時比較推力、速度與軸功率，排除不同測點的最大值拼接。
quiz.explanationEn: Useful forward-flight power is thrust times speed; dividing by shaft power gives propulsive efficiency, which is not a useful hover comparison at zero speed. Compare thrust, speed and shaft power simultaneously rather than joining maxima from different conditions.

steps.title: 旋轉階次追蹤：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rotational-order tracking: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 旋轉階次追蹤 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rotational-order tracking and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 每轉事件頻率等於轉速除60，葉片通過頻率再乘葉片數；階次追蹤可把轉速變化和固定共振分開。
steps.instructionEn: Once-per-revolution frequency is rpm/60 and blade-passing frequency multiplies blade count; order tracking separates speed changes from fixed resonances.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非De Havilland Dash 8 客機工程實際性能或製程：n=600 rpm，B=4片。式 fBPF=Bn/60，基準結果 40 Hz。適用條件：理想均勻旋轉，不據此指定配重、槳距或真機調整。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for De Havilland Dash 8 airliner engineering: n=600 rpm and B=4 blades. Formula fBPF=Bn/60 gives 40 Hz. Conditions: Ideal uniform rotation, without specifying balance weights, blade pitch or real-aircraft adjustments.
steps.failure: 速度改變後頻率移動不必然是新故障，先看是否固定階次。
steps.failureEn: A frequency shift after a speed change is not necessarily a new fault; check its order.
steps.check: 將轉速參考脈衝與振動時序同步，對比Hz頻譜與階次譜。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize tachometer pulses and vibration and compare Hz spectra with order spectra.

steps.objective: 重算 旋轉階次追蹤 的教學算例，核對單位與適用條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Recalculate the teaching example for Rotational-order tracking and verify units and assumptions.
steps.instruction: 原創教學假設，非De Havilland Dash 8 客機工程實際性能或製程：n=600 rpm，B=4片。式 fBPF=Bn/60，基準結果 40 Hz。適用條件：理想均勻旋轉，不據此指定配重、槳距或真機調整。
steps.instructionEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for De Havilland Dash 8 airliner engineering: n=600 rpm and B=4 blades. Formula fBPF=Bn/60 gives 40 Hz. Conditions: Ideal uniform rotation, without specifying balance weights, blade pitch or real-aircraft adjustments.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非De Havilland Dash 8 客機工程實際性能或製程：n=600 rpm，B=4片。式 fBPF=Bn/60，基準結果 40 Hz。適用條件：理想均勻旋轉，不據此指定配重、槳距或真機調整。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for De Havilland Dash 8 airliner engineering: n=600 rpm and B=4 blades. Formula fBPF=Bn/60 gives 40 Hz. Conditions: Ideal uniform rotation, without specifying balance weights, blade pitch or real-aircraft adjustments.
steps.failure: 速度改變後頻率移動不必然是新故障，先看是否固定階次。
steps.failureEn: A frequency shift after a speed change is not necessarily a new fault; check its order.
steps.check: 將轉速參考脈衝與振動時序同步，對比Hz頻譜與階次譜。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize tachometer pulses and vibration and compare Hz spectra with order spectra.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把n改成660 rpm；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 40 改為 44 Hz。在算式區重算並記下對「旋轉階次追蹤」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only n to 660 rpm, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 40 to 44 Hz. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Rotational-order tracking, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.
